Screen PPI Calculator

Calculate a display's pixels-per-inch (PPI) from its diagonal size and resolution, plus megapixels and aspect ratio.

PPI = √(w² + h²) ÷ diagonal inches.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the screen diagonal in inches.
  2. Enter the horizontal and vertical resolution in pixels.
  3. Read the PPI, total megapixels and simplified aspect ratio.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is PPI?

Pixels per inch: the diagonal pixel count (by Pythagoras) divided by the diagonal screen size in inches. Higher PPI means sharper text and images.

What is a good PPI?

Phones are usually 300-500 PPI, laptops 150-250 PPI, and desktop monitors 90-160 PPI. Above ~300 PPI at phone distance, pixels are invisible to most eyes.

Does PPI affect performance?

Yes. Rendering more pixels costs GPU power, which is why games offer resolution scaling.
